title: Two-venue Korean premium (Upbit + Bithumb) for the v8 altcoin-kimchi sleeve
registered: 2026-10-21, before the Bithumb data exists (get_bithumb.bat on the user's PC)
rule: per altcoin: kp_u (Upbit) and kp_b (Bithumb) computed exactly as Gen247 A (KRW close at 23:00 UTC / USD-KRW previous London day / Binance perp close - 1); kp = mean(kp_u, kp_b) where both exist, kp_u otherwise; 30-day z (min 20); z > 1 long 0.1, z < -1 short 0.1, next day. REPLACES the alt-kimchi sleeve of v8.1
why: two venues measure the same Korean demand; averaging cuts venue-specific noise (Makarov-Schoar: the common component dominates)
